territory: Domain shift: domain adaptation/generalization, test-time adaptation, distribution-shift robustness, cross-site/cross-sensor transfer; academic ML only
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields in order (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, core_claim, method_sketch, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, novelty_hook, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, kill_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label). Following the convention of earlier Wave A shards, alias fields mirror their counterparts as closely related but non-identical prose: core_claim complements core_hypothesis, minimal_falsification_experiment complements method_sketch, novelty_hook complements why_possibly_novel, kill_risk complements main_risk. Every candidate states the community default belief, why it might be wrong, and a cheapest/fastest falsifying experiment.

compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or experimental results; all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels, and dataset/model families are referenced generically as proposed experiment subjects.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows directories created; no Windows numbers changed; only the two mandated files written under Windows16/_state/tasks/P1/.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 100 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard conceptual neighbors were minimized but remain for dedup review: dshf-0009 vs dshf-0022/dshf-0045/dshf-0073 (layer-wise divergence profiles reused as routing, alignment-depth, diagnosis, and unfreezing signals), dshf-0001 vs dshf-0017/dshf-0037/dshf-0050 (label-free collapse/overfitting/harm monitors for adaptation), dshf-0008 vs dshf-0078/dshf-0081 (label-prior estimation feeding objectives, estimator audits, and abstention), dshf-0011 vs dshf-0036/dshf-0041 (reusable adaptation state as snapshots, composable deltas, and trajectory warm starts), dshf-0016 vs dshf-0081 (abstention-threshold adaptation under shift vs under prior shift).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-01 SAM/PEFT (dshf-0067 PEFT robustness, dshf-0074 frozen-encoder adaptation), genA-02 medical segmentation (cross_site_medical_scientific cluster, especially dshf-0051..dshf-0056), genA-06 failure mining (dshf-0046/dshf-0047/dshf-0050 harm monitoring), genA-07 benchmark weaknesses (evaluation_and_model_selection cluster, especially dshf-0085, dshf-0088, dshf-0089), and genA-08 uncertainty (dshf-0016, dshf-0053, dshf-0072, dshf-0081 calibration/abstention themes); dedup should treat these as high-collision zones.

Several candidates require resources beyond a single-lab minimal experiment: dshf-0051 (factorial re-scan/re-stain clinical data), dshf-0071 (factorial pretraining compute), dshf-0089 (evaluation-server curation and operation); their fastest-falsifying experiments are scoped-down pilots.

Candidates dshf-0026, dshf-0084, dshf-0088, dshf-0090 presuppose reproducing published-style baselines locally under matched budgets; feasibility depends on public availability of the relevant method implementations.
